records.name: Dragon Burn
records.skill_description: Abruptly raise your body temperature and touch enemies to set them on fire.
records.mechanics_notes: Counter/evasive hybrid. The user enters a brief defensive stance; an opponent attacking during the active window is paralyzed and burned for about three seconds. Classified as a Ki Blast Evasive despite contact-based counter behavior.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ82 — Ultimate Brotherly Battle. Ultimate Finish requirement remains unresolved; no unsupported drop probability recorded.
records.pve_notes: The counter punishes attacks into the stance with paralysis and burn.
records.pvp_notes: Exact active frames, hitbox behavior, and version-specific damage remain unresolved.
